description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers end-to-end logo / brand mark generation requests. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: general image generation (image-generation), banner/social asset production (brand-asset-generation), routing-only questions (image-provider-routing), prompt-authoring-only (prompt-engineering-image), and rights checks (image-likeness-and-rights).

queries.q: generate a logo for my bakery called Golden Crust
create a brand mark for our SaaS startup — minimalist, dark blue, no text
I need a vector SVG logo for our coffee shop
design a wordmark logo for our law firm with clean sans-serif type
produce a combination mark logo — icon plus company name — for our fitness app
generate a hero image for our homepage
create a banner for our bakery's Instagram with the seasonal offer
which provider should I use for a logo with text inside?
write me a Recraft prompt for a minimalist geometric logo mark
can I use a design that looks like the Apple logo as inspiration for my mark?
